verdict.summary: The workflow change is correct and complete as scoped. ARCHIVE_FEATURES is consistently shared by archive construction, doctests, and the new nextest-list non-vacuity guard. The guard selects sparq-vectors' simd::tests with the same workspace/all-target/features configuration and fails if the feature-gated module disappears. The bulk-shard preflight correctly requires x86_64 plus both AVX2 and FMA, matching active_kernel's dispatch predicate; the existing CI-armed test independently verifies the real dispatcher path, so the /proc/cpuinfo check is not treated as sole evidence. Heavy shards do not run SIMD tests, while the three bulk partitions cover the non-heavy suite. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was present in the diff.
